lines.t: The Love of Man
A quiet place, a holy rest
All I am is yours to keep
You sing me softly out of sleep
Your light in the hollow
Fills every space
Your mercy surrounds me
Your love is grace
From ashes you lift me
You call my name
Unconditional, forever the same
The world taught love was just a flame
That flickers out that can't remain
But you are fire that never dies
A steady glow that lights the skies
You warm the coldest part of me
Your truth restores what used to be
In your arms I finally see
What love was always meant to be
If I must fall, let it be to rise
To see your hope in these tired eyes
Your cup runs over and I believe
Your joy is the breath I breathe
Your light in the hollow breaks through the dark
Your mercy forever consumes my heart
Yahushua, my refuge, my soul redeemed
Unconditional love, forever you'll be
Thank you for watching!
